idea-plugin.name: Local Prompt Optimizer
idea-plugin.description:
Local prompt optimization, semantic cache reuse, and token cost forecasting for IntelliJ IDEs — without leaving the editor.

  • Compresses filler words and redundant phrasing before sending to an AI
  • Checks a local SQLite semantic cache for similar past results
  • Estimates token cost before the request leaves your machine
  • Packs active-file and run-console context automatically
  • Detects accidental API keys and secrets in prompts

Requires Node.js 18+ on your system PATH.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.9.7
Brings the IntelliJ plugin closer to the VS Code experience: modes, target-model tuning, workspace memory, peer workspace controls, cache/knowledge/file-digest status, health and maintenance actions, richer secret detection, and an in-plugin onboarding guide.
